# [CS069] Large Function (large-function)

A function is longer than metrics.max_function_loc lines.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Code Metrics |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Long functions (default limit 80 lines) are hard to read in one screen and usually do several things. Extract steps into named functions.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
func handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { /* 150 lines */ }
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
func handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	req, err := decode(r)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, process(req))
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [large-function]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    large-function: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore large-function -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** large-function
```
